subject.title: fix(gateway): generate dashboard titles despite sender metadata

question: Should generated dashboard titles make one primary-model retry after a distinct utility-model failure, accepting the additional provider call and its cost/latency behavior?
rationale: This is an intentional compatibility-sensitive behavior change rather than a purely mechanical bug repair, and the PR carries the protected `maintainer` label.

options.title: Accept the bounded retry
options.body: Approve one primary-model retry after a distinct utility-model failure once redacted after-fix evidence confirms the dashboard behavior.

options.title: Keep the original single-attempt behavior
options.body: Retain the dashboard sender-title fix but remove the retry path if predictable single-call cost and latency are preferred.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded retry
recommendation.body: Approve one primary-model retry after a distinct utility-model failure once redacted after-fix evidence confirms the dashboard behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied timeline shows this person authored the retry design and assigned the PR, making them the best available routing candidate from the visible evidence.
